Resolved from evidence: chair hand-offs, readers of resolutions, name plates on camera, and ECAPA voiceprints seeded from evidence-anchored turns (this meeting) plus a cross-meeting check against 2026-10-06. Short interjections with no voice margin keep their cluster's default, as on 2026-10-06.

notes: Roll call from the chair (0:00:05): 'We have 6 of our 7 board members present. Our 7th board member ... she's not able to be here.' The six who spoke in board-member comments are Zendler, Potts, Melton, Haupt, Alic and Anne, so the absent trustee is Nancy Philippart. Every vote is announced 6-0.
A = Vital Anne, chair ('Hi, my name is Vital' 0:00:05). Cross-meeting voiceprint vs 2026-10-06 Anne 0.72.

I = Kristine Griffor and D = Christine DiPilato -- the identifier had I as DiPilato. I presented the ELEMENTARY data ('Questions for elementary?' 0:42:59) and D middle and high school ('excited to ... talk a little bit about middle school ... and then into high school' 0:44:56); the chair addresses D as 'Christine' (0:55:10). On 2026-10-06 Griffor (Asst. Supt. Elementary) presented elementary and DiPilato (plate CHRISTINE DiPILATO / ASST SUPT SECONDARY INSTRUCTION) secondary. ECAPA cross-meeting: I vs 10-06 Griffor 0.82 (vs DiPilato -0.01); D vs 10-06 DiPilato 0.63 (vs Griffor 0.01). Controls: Trudel 0.79, Anne 0.72, Alic 0.69, Haupt 0.78. 'Christine' and 'Kristine' sound alike, so the chair's 1:13:31 'Thanks, Kristine' cannot decide it.

C = Dr. Richard Machesky (answers 'Dr. Machesky' at 0:25:44 and 1:43:23). N = Dan Trudel (presents 8.A-8.D; 'Mr. Trudel' 1:13:47). J = Emina Alic (reads the 8.A and 8.D resolutions when the chair asks 'Miss Alicia'; election reminder 1:42:32). K = Audra Melton (reads the Learning Disabilities resolution after 'Dr. Melton'; frame 0:15:30 shows a trustee reading from a sheet, seated by plate order at DR. AUDRA MELTON; the dais is curved, so plate-to-seat is inferred). L = Stephanie Zendler (Principal Appreciation resolution after 'Ms. Zandler'; board comments after 'Ms. Zender'). B = Ayesha Potts ('Ms. Cotts' reads 8.B; board comments; plate AYESHA POTTS). P = Matt Haupt (consent resolution after 'Mr. Haupt'; board comments after 'Mr. Haunt'; 0:29:09 vs his other lines 0.79; cross-meeting 0.78).

G = Lindsay Keegan, Schroeder principal (Machesky: 'Schroeder principal, Mrs. Lindsay Keegan'); frame 0:03:30 shows a woman with a handheld mic beside the podium leading the students. Her lines filed under D (0:02:22, 0:08:32, 0:09:09) by voice (0.38-0.47 vs <=0.25), and F 0:02:09 ('Thanks, Dr. [Machesky], and the board') by context.
E/H = Schroeder students (Nicholas, Remy, Audrey, Veeram, Dean, by their own introductions). The children's voices are too alike to separate per child (centroids 0.57-0.76), so they share one label.

O = Alex Karpowitsch, the only public commenter (chair: 'Mr. Alex Karpowitz'; self: 'my name is Alex Karpowicz ... 2004 Troy High graduate'); the STT spelling is wrong, Karpowitsch is the archive owner's name. O's later one-word lines are not his (he spoke at the podium once): 1:15:30 'Support.' is Haupt (chair: 'supported by Mr. Hauff'), 1:42:11 'That's great.' is Haupt by voice (0.38 vs 0.18).

Student reps by name plate (frames 1:24:30-1:26:25): Ahyoung Song / INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY EAST, Shyanne Kurzynski / TROY COLLEGE & CAREER HIGH SCHOOL. The chair's 'Shane' is Shyanne. TCCHS is one speaker: the camera shows the Kurzynski seat speaking at 1:25:36, 1:25:47 and 1:26:25, and every TCCHS line -- filed under D, K and M -- matches the 1:25:33 voice (0.44-0.74). Athens had no rep ('We do not have an Athens rep today').

M = the Troy High rep, sitting behind the LANDON IBRAHIM / TROY HIGH SCHOOL plate (frame 1:27:30), but introduced by the chair as a substitute heard as 'Leah Bozeman'; that spelling appears nowhere in the archive, so the label is the role.

Context calls: J 0:14:29 'Sure.' answers 'Dr. Melton, you said you were going to do that?' (Melton); I 0:24:26 'Support.' (chair: 'supported by Ms. Potts'); B 0:43:36 'We sure have.' answers the chair's question to the presenters (Griffor by voice 0.31 vs 0.19, and Griffor's 'Our team has.' follows); G 1:23:23 'Yep.' answers the chair's sinking-fund question to Trudel; G 1:31:58 'Sure.' answers 'Ms. Zender, do you want to kick it off?'; D 1:13:57 'I wish I could say this was more exciting' is Trudel by voice (0.64).

Unidentified speaker: one-to-three-word interjections and vote 'Yes.'es in clusters whose owner was not speaking (guest clusters after the guest left, staff clusters during votes), where neither voice nor context names anyone.
Presentation frames (0:33:00-1:05:00) are slide-only and identify neither presenter; the voiceprints and the agenda split (elementary vs secondary) decide I and D.
